knobs.note: BH-3434: rows claimed per tick, and owed comments re-driven per tick. Read at lane level by bin/hub-probe.sh as ${HUB_PROBE_TICK_CAP:-10}. 0 means nothing is claimed or re-driven.

BH-3434: runs of one probe per UTC day (hp_count_today). A claimed row at or over the cap goes back to pending with the note `deferred: daily cap`. Read by bin/hub-probe.sh as ${HUB_PROBE_DAILY_CAP:-20}. 0 means every row defers.

Test seam: a file bin/hub-probe.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (tests/hub-probe-lane.bh-3434-test.sh). NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/hub-probe.sh sources HUB_PROBE_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
